variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 1SA.7.9 reads 'and offered it for a whole burnt-offering unto Jehovah', with an unitalicized 'it' whose antecedent is the sucking lamb just named. The qere ויעלהו carries an explicit 3ms object suffix, but the ketiv ויעלה is equally renderable with an expressed object (whether read as an unsuffixed form whose object is the lamb already in view, or vocalized with a suffix), so the English pronoun does not discriminate between the two consonantal forms. The verse carries no ASV note classed textual_variant mapped to this unit, and nothing else in the wording turns on the suffix. Underdetermined; the qere base fallback carries the projection.
